title_en: Half a jin is eight liang

lines.text: 每年七月，公司都要从马来西亚槟城的一家合作工厂订一批月饼，赶在中秋节以前卖给欧洲的华人超市。

lines.en: Every July, the company orders a batch of mooncakes from a partner factory in Penang, Malaysia, to sell to Chinese supermarkets in Europe before the Mid-Autumn Festival.

lines.en: Suddenly Jack remembers a chengyu Teacher Li taught in class: ban jin ba liang, "half a jin, eight liang", meaning two people or things are much the same.
